summary: Entity 835 in the Gleditsch–Ward state list, as mapped by CShapes 2.0, a dataset of the borders and capitals of states and dependencies between 1886 and 2019. The dataset gives it 1 period of territorial validity, from 1888 to 1983. The source calls it "Brunei"; the names on this record are the ones data/imports/cshapes-actors.json gives it. Its last capital in the dataset is Bandar Seri Begawan. The code is mapped onto more than one actor (data/imports/cshapes-actors.json); this record holds the periods before the first cut. This record was written by the import from those fields and asserts nothing the dataset does not.
